classes.$comment: The seven classes the school admits into, rendered by classCard() into the .classes grid on the Admission page. Add or edit an entry here and it appears after the next build — no markup changes needed. `mark` is the short level numeral shown on the card; `tone` is one of teal / amber / coral.
classes.title: Seven classes, one clear path.
classes.text: Edulife runs from Nursery through Class Five. Each year builds on the one before it, so a child can grow with us from their very first school day to the end of primary.

ctaSteps.$comment: The closing admission section on the homepage: the five-step journey on the left, the admission inquiry form on the right. Edit copy here only. NOTE the five STEPS are deliberately NOT stored here — they come from the shared `admissionSteps` array above, which /admission renders too, so the two pages can never describe a different process. The form's class dropdown is generated from `classes.items`, so adding a class updates the grid and the form together.
ctaSteps.title: How admission works.
ctaSteps.text: No hidden stages, no pressure. Read the five steps, then send your inquiry without leaving this page — every step exists to make sure the school and the family are a good fit for each other.
ctaSteps.note: This demo form validates in your browser and stores nothing.
ctaSteps.success: Thank you — your inquiry has been noted. Our team will be in touch within one working day.

initiatives.$comment:
The Edulife family of initiatives. Rendered by initiativeCard() into the .initiatives grid on the homepage. Add or edit an entry here and it appears after the next build - no markup changes needed.
  logo  -> a PNG/JPG in src/assets/images/initiatives/ (square, transparent, ~192px). REPLACE THESE with the real brand logos; the shipped files are placeholder marks drawn to match the site palette.
  alt   -> the image's alt text. The initiative name is also rendered as text, so keep this descriptive but short.
  url   -> the initiative's OWN website. THESE ARE PLACEHOLDERS (example.com) - replace all six. Set url to "" to fall back to href, an in-site page.
  icon  -> optional SVG fallback used when logo is blank or its file is missing, from the icon set in assets/js/renderers.js (cap, pen, balloon, pages, apple, chip).
  href  -> in-site page used when url is empty.
